test_title: PYST 36: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

#: UEQ :: VFR: %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : UEQ :: VFR : %

**Option 1) # = KUG, % = FPU**

**For # (KUG) to UEQ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b5c82e39794a05667bc93ef571e481e97b7939b43fa5652137ddd85111e8f19.png] 

The pattern derived from KUG to UEQ is: (+10, +10, +10).

**For VFR to % (FPU)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/290e06933d248f058f45915cb4ce490545893409deb210b5b51eade10959d7b4.png] 

The pattern derived from VFR to FPU is: (+10, +10, +3).

Since the patterns do not match, Option 1 is incorrect.

**Option 2) # = KTG, % = FPB**

**For # (KTG) to UEQ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b23ee977ff61952167832490df9b265d89ae462cfb8479468f8f258a9ff19294.png] 

The pattern derived from KTG to UEQ is: (+10, +11, +10).

**For VFR to % (FPB)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/042fecc6ab22d0d730e047b93965278cfa1037d80b120e8623b3b6267ccfd736.png] 

The pattern derived from VFR to FPB is: (+10, +10, +10).

Since the patterns do not match, Option 2 is incorrect.

**Option 3) # = KUG, % = FPB**

**For # (KUG) to UEQ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c053a73f223f1f08abeea9b5ec431ef9163389554f075a6e7471e0f573c82b7.png] 

The pattern derived from KUG to UEQ is: (+10, +10, +10).

**For VFR to % (FPB)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2a32c0263fce44c9854b82b02d905a2f2132555308e4640d0fc64626a18b665.png] 

The pattern derived from VFR to FPB is: (+10, +10, +10).

Since the patterns for both pairs match, Option 3 is the correct answer.

**Option 4) #LUG, % = FPB**

**For # (LUG) to UEQ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e7be5b6a09464c0b4e614fb1b6bd394c67731f8136cc5ea0d1b5ad3093a66da.png] 

The pattern derived from LUG to UEQ is: (+9, +10, +10).

**For VFR to % (FPB)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cad61beccef41d9f55411feaffc9f21bd672b414739dcb8352d304864711f063.png] 

The pattern derived from VFR to FPB is: (+10, +10, +10).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
